"""Generation 1: Adds robust detection for US postal ADDRESSES while preserving existing PII detectors.
"""
import re

PATTERNS = [
    ("EMAIL", re.compile(r"[\w.]+@[\w]+\.\w+")),
    ("PHONE", re.compile(r"\d{3}-\d{3}-\d{4}")),
    ("SSN", re.compile(r"\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b")),
    ("CREDIT_CARD", re.compile(r"\b\d{16}\b")),
    ("ADDRESS", re.compile(
        r"\d+\s+[A-Z0-9a-z\.\,\#\-\s]+\b(?:"
        r"Apt\.?|Apartment|Suite|Ste\.?|Unit|Room|Fl\.?|Floor"
        r")\s*[A-Z0-9a-z\-\#\.]+,?\s*"
        r"[A-Z][a-zA-Z\s\.,]+,\s*(?:AL|AK|AZ|AR|CA|CO|CT|DE|DC|FL|GA|HI|ID|IL|IN|IA|KS|KY|LA|ME|MD|MA|MI|MN|MS|MO|MT|NE|NV|NH|NJ|NM|NY|NC|ND|OH|OK|OR|PA|RI|SC|SD|TN|TX|UT|VT|VA|WA|WV|WI|WY|AS|GU|MP|PR|VI|FM)\s+\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?"
        r"|"
        r"\d+\s+[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9\.\,\#\-\s\n]+,\s*"
        r"[A-Z][a-zA-Z\s\.,]+,?\s+"
        r"(?:AL|AK|AZ|AR|CA|CO|CT|DE|DC|FL|GA|HI|ID|IL|IN|IA|KS|KY|LA|ME|MD|MA|MI|MN|MS|MO|MT|NE|NV|NH|NJ|NM|NY|NC|ND|OH|OK|OR|PA|RI|SC|SD|TN|TX|UT|VT|VA|WA|WV|WI|WY|AS|GU|MP|PR|VI|FM)\s+\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?"
        r"|"
        r"\d+\s+[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9\.\,\#\-]+\s+[A-Za-z\s]+(?:Street|St\.?|Road|Rd\.?|Avenue|Ave\.?|Boulevard|Blvd\.?|Drive|Dr\.?|Lane|Ln\.?|Way|Court|Ct\.?|Circle|Cir\.?|Trail|Trl\.?|Motorway|Underpass|Plains|Views?|Heights|Parkway|Pkwy\.?|Loop|Walks?|Fords?|Lodges?|Harbor)\s*"
        r"(?:[A-Z][a-zA-Z\s\.,\-]+)?\s+"
        r"(?:AL|AK|AZ|AR|CA|CO|CT|DE|DC|FL|GA|HI|ID|IL|IN|IA|KS|KY|LA|ME|MD|MA|MI|MN|MS|MO|MT|NE|NV|NH|NJ|NM|NY|NC|ND|OH|OK|OR|PA|RI|SC|SD|TN|TX|UT|VT|VA|WA|WV|WI|WY|AS|GU|MP|PR|VI|FM)\s+\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?"
        r")",
        re.IGNORECASE
    )),
]


def find_pii(text):
    """Return a list of (start, end, label) spans that contain PII."""
    spans = []
    for label, pattern in PATTERNS:
        for m in pattern.finditer(text):
            spans.append((m.start(), m.end(), label))
    return spans
